title: Two Italian technicians killed in drone strike in Kuwait
seoTitle: Two Italian technicians killed in Kuwait drone strike
dek: Two Italian technicians working for defense contractor Rheinmetall were killed in a drone attack in Kuwait, as regional tensions and attacks escalate.
happened: On 26 November 2026, two Italian technicians employed by Rheinmetall Italia were killed in a drone strike in Kuwait. According to Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani, the victims were working at an air-defense detection station targeted by drones. Kuwait's Ministry of Defense initially reported that four people were wounded by falling debris at a vital site, and later confirmed that the two injured Italians died from their injuries. Colonel Saud Al-Atwan stated that Kuwait Armed Forces detected hostile airspace activity and blamed Iranian aggression. The Kuwaiti military also reported that a Kuwaiti national and a Pakistani national were injured. The Iranian army denied conducting operations in the region. Meanwhile, Saudi Arabia and the Houthi movement reported fresh security incidents, including a Houthi claim of an attack on the Ras Tanura oil refinery and Riyadh, alongside vessel attacks near the Strait of Hormuz.

sides.says: Italian Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani confirmed the deaths of the two compatriots, stating that Iranian-origin drones targeted a Kuwaiti military installation where the Rheinmetall Italia technicians were working. Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni also expressed condolences.

Colonel Saud Al-Atwan stated that Kuwaiti forces detected hostile drones in the country's airspace and blamed heinous Iranian aggression. The ministry confirmed that four people were initially injured by falling debris at a vital site, and that the two injured Italian workers subsequently died from their wounds.
An Iranian military spokesperson denied responsibility for the attack on the Kuwaiti site, asserting that the army had conducted no operations in the region.

next: The Italian Embassy in Kuwait remains in constant contact with local authorities to monitor developments and assist the families of the victims.
summary: Two Italian defense technicians working for Rheinmetall Italia were killed in a drone strike at a military installation in Kuwait. Kuwaiti defense officials attributed the attack to Iranian aggression, while the Iranian military denied involvement. The incident injured two other individuals, a Kuwaiti national and a Pakistani national, and occurred amidst rising security incidents across the Gulf region, including attacks on shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and infrastructure in Saudi Arabia.
